How It Works

How gittgo100 Helps Your Business Grow

Growing a successful business takes more than attending networking events. That's why gittgo100 combines trusted relationships, intelligent introductions and genuine customer enquiries to create more opportunities for your business.

Independently vetted

Every gittgo100 member is checked and interviewed before they're offered a seat.

Trusted Business Relationships

Meet around 100 independently vetted local business owners through four carefully planned networking events each year.

With one business per category, every relationship has the potential to become a trusted source of opportunities, recommendations and long-term business.

The networking doesn't end when the event finishes. Members stay connected through our exclusive WhatsApp community, helping conversations become introductions, and introductions become business opportunities.

Intelligent Business Introductions

Every member completes our Easy Data Analytics (EDA) profile, helping us understand not only what they do, but what they need right now.

This allows us to make intelligent introductions based on genuine business opportunities, not chance encounters.

You complete your EDATell us what you offer, and what you need, right now.

gittgo matches the roomLive demand, matched to the right member.

C

Frequently Asked Questions

Questions Essex business owners ask us

How much does membership cost?+

£25 + VAT per month. Cancel anytime.

Is there a contract?+

No. Membership is on a rolling monthly basis.

Can more than one business from the same category join?+

No. gittgo100 operates a one business per category policy, helping protect the value of every membership.

How are businesses selected?+

Every business is independently vetted before joining.

How does gittgo concierge work?+

gittgo concierge connects genuine customer enquiries from the local community with carefully vetted gittgo members.

When are the networking events?+

Members attend four carefully planned networking events each year and stay connected through the exclusive members' WhatsApp community between events.
